description: This source file defines internal static class CatalogInstruments, which manages various performance and operational metrics related to activation processes within the Orleans runtime. It creates counters and gauges for metrics such as failed activations, collection numbers, shutdown events, and activation counts.

classes.name: CatalogInstruments
classes.description: A static class that encapsulates various metrics instruments used in the Orleans runtime to monitor activation-related events and states.

methods.name: ActivationShutdownViaCollection
methods.description: Records an activation shutdown event via collection by incrementing the corresponding counter with context indicating 'collection'.

methods.name: ActivationShutdownViaDeactivateOnIdle
methods.description: Records an activation shutdown event via deactivate on idle by incrementing the counter with context 'deactivateOnIdle'.

methods.name: ActivationShutdownViaMigration
methods.description: Records an activation shutdown event via migration with the appropriate context.

methods.name: ActivationShutdownViaDeactivateStuckActivation
methods.description: Records an activation shutdown event due to stuck activation with corresponding context.

methods.name: RegisterActivationCountObserve
methods.description: Sets up the observable gauge for activation count, providing a callback to observe current value.

methods.name: RegisterActivationWorkingSetObserve
methods.description: Sets up the observable gauge for activation working set size, with a callback for observation.
